payload.description_as_reported: Loss aversion strength depended on measurement format, with fill-in-the-loss formats increasing loss aversion; the psychophysics of value induce risk aversion in the domain of gains and risk seeking in the domain of losses.

domain_transfer.source_domain: Judgment and Decision Making; risky and riskless contexts

payload.pattern: When a user is about to commit to a choice, present the negative consequence of that choice above or before the positive consequence, and scale the visual weight of the negative consequence to be {loss_magnitude} times more prominent than the positive consequence, triggering this treatment once the user has interacted with the choice {loss_focus_threshold} time(s).
